join_piece_note: an output that starts inside a note's join window and answers nothing: one glide cut into two. Neither a duplicate of a truth note (spurious) nor a lost output (dangling) — it is the join being chopped, so it gets its own bucket rather than being forced into either.
merged_note: merged is a second axis, not a bucket: it says how the answer was shaped (one output covering two notes), while correct/wrong/missing says whether the pitch was right. A note can be both correct and merged. merged_notes + solo_notes = counted_notes; merged notes are by construction answered, so they can never be missing.
align_why: does not reproduce: 3 on A, -11 on C, -7 on s1, -3 on s2, -6 on s3, -8 on s4, -8 on s5, -1 on s6, -5 on s7, 0 on s8, -6 on s9 — a band of 14 ms across 11 samples of different material, against a 10 ms bar
